scope: Wood-carbon 2E Fig. 8: (a) NaCl and (b) phosphate. Review same-source two panels separately under approved 10% and 20% windows.
sequence: Retrieve the official PMC publisher PDF and verify its listed checksum and identity. Inventory only page and native object dimensions for the target figure; never render the full plot.

Use black-only exterior tick labels or publisher caption roles to verify axes and exclude other panels. Do not release interiors until plot rectangles are established. Then apply the Phase 46 boundary to both early windows and release only the trace band without terminal annotation.

Compare at least two thresholds for reading distinct independent marker centers; record zero when spacing, overlap or marker definition prevents a reliable count. Record uncertainty near window boundaries. Retain 10 mA as absolute and require source-bound role and normalization before prediction lock.
negative_control: For each reviewed geometry, changing every late plot pixel must leave the two early crops and outside-axis crops byte-identical. Early positive control must change only early crops.
admission_boundary: Figure-digitized early values if justified, no imputation and no inaccessible CSV claim. Related articles remain one provisional cluster; no actual fits, prediction lock, exact endpoint reveal or formal independent acceptance in this phase.
